newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-CLEAN BILL OF HEALTH FOR GROGGY PSG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLEAN BILL OF HEALTH FOR GROGGY PSG.

text.p: French first division pacesetters Paris Saint-Germain ays of regular clean sheets are back after clearing out their sickbay this week.
"The infirmary is empty at last," said manager Ricardo on Thursday as he named his side for Friday's away match at Rennes, where PSG hope to end a slump in form.

With the return of French international goalkeeper Bernard Lama, out for nearly six weeks following knee surgery, PSG will field the central defensive unit that did not concede a goal in 624 minutes of football until Lama's injury against Cannes.
Alain Roche, who missed the 1-1 draw at home to champions Auxerre last weekend, and defensive midfielder Bruno N'Gotty return to link up with central defender Paul Le Guen.
Left back Jose Cobos, however, will miss the match through suspension after being sent off against Auxerre.
PSG, licking their wounds after a 4-2 away defeat to Turkey's Galatasaray in a second-round European Cup Winners' Cup match eight days ago, conceded a last minute equaliser to Auxerre last weekend.
